## 3. Key Wave 3b Findings ($N_{\mathrm{zones}} = 4096$)

1. **4D tabulated EOS (`eos_4d`)**: At 4096 zones, 4-thread Safe Rust runs in `839.76 us` vs. `2697.28 us` in MESA (`3.21x`), and GPU `@jax.jit(jax.vmap)` reaches `333.70 us` per profile (`8.08x`).
2. **Networks and atmospheres**: At 4096 zones and 4 threads, Safe Rust evaluates `net_eval` in `5411.82 us` vs. `26085.18 us` in MESA (`4.82x`), and `atm_table` in `255.46 us` vs. `1954.16 us` in MESA (`7.65x`).
